n: USC Scalar Teaching Data Literacy in Social Studies
t: A Scalar website that helps teachers teach data visualization in social studies.
steps: Open the Scalar site in a browser.
Read the taxonomy and the page on visualizations as primary sources.
Find the lesson plan index for your school level.
Open the Progress of the Civil War lesson.
Skip pages that still hold placeholder text.
Read the minimal manual for any tool you plan to use.
Check the tools the lessons name before class.
